REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT Francisco Gold Condominium II, EDSA cor. Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City OFFICE OF SECRETARY 3 2006 23 December 2005 VICE MAYOR DANILO B. IACUNA Manila Dear Sir: This refers to your request for this Department's opinion on the extent and nature of the power of your office in extending recognition to Mr. Natalio F. Beltran III as an ex-officio Member of the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Manila. In particular, you have posited the following queries which we quote, viz: I. "Can the Office of the City Vice Mayor implement the Resolution of the Supreme Court dated August 31, 2005? Does the continuous assumption of Mr. Cartos Castaneda as the President of the Liga ng Barangay of Manila, despite knowledge of the decision Of the Regional Trial Court, Branch 33, and the Resolution of the Honorable Supreme Court, constitute contemptuous act? 2. Is the power of the Office of the City Vice Mayor to recognize Natatio F. Beltran as the duly elected president of the Liga ng mga Barangay, vice Mr. Carlos Castaneda, pure',y a ministerial one? Does such recognition need the concurrence of the members of the City Council? Attached herewith are the documents presented by Natatio F. Beltran in relation to his assumption of office as an ex-officio member of the City Council?

-2- 3. Should the Office of the City Vice Mayor extend recognition to Natatio F. Beltran as the duty elected president of the Liga ng mga Barangay, what would be its effect on the ZegisZative acts of Mr. Cartos Castaneda whose assumption of office as an ex- officio member of the City Council was declared void ab initio?" Before addressing the abovestated issues, may we briefly re-state the related factual antecedents, based on our records, for a clearer appreciation of our reply, to wit: On 30 May 2002, the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Manila (SPM for brevity) enacted City Ordinance No. 8039, entitled: "An Ordinance Prescribing A Procedure of Election of Officers of the Liga ng mga Barangay and the Pan Zungsod na Pederasyon ng Sangguniang Kabataan in the City of Manila" whereby the dates of the elections for the District and City Chapters of the Liga and SK (Manila Chapter) were scheduled thirty (30) days after the elections of the barangay; On 09 July 2002, the Liga ng mga Barangay, represented by its officials, filed a Petition for Declaratory Relief before the Regional Trial Court of Manila, Branch 33, docketed as Civil Case No. 02-103996, praying that City Ordinance No. 8039 (supra) be declared unconstitutional and invalid. On 15 July 2002, the Synchronized Barangay and SK Elections were held where Messrs. Beltran and Carlos Castaöeda separately ran and won as Punong Barangays; Thereafter, the Liga elections pursuant to the Manila City Ordinance were held that led to the election of Mr. Castaneda as "Liga Manila Chapter President". As such, Mr. Castafieda took his oath and assumed the Liga presidency and acted post as Ex-Officio Member of the SPM; In the meantime, Mr. Beltran also ran and won as Liga Manila Chapter President in the elections called for by the Liga ng Mga Barangay and per a Certificate of Confirmation dated 23 October 2002, issued by Mr. James Marty L Lim (National President of the Liga ng mga Barangay),

-3- Mr. Beltran has been confirmed as such; On 12 November 2002, Mr. Beltran took his oath as Liga ng mga Barangay President (Manila Chapter) before former Vice President Teofisto T. Guingona; However, per information from DILG City Director of Manila, Atty. Vedasto D. Bassi, Mr. Beltran was not able to assume his post as ex- officio Member of the SPM because Mr. Carlos Castaneda, as "Liga Chapter President" pursuant to the assailed City Ordinance No. 8039, was already sitting as ex-officio Member of the SPM; • Through a Decision dated 21 February 2003, the RTC, Branch 33, rendered a judgment declaring Manila City Ordinance No. 8039 as invalid; The Motion for Reconsideration on the said Decision was denied for lack of merit by the RTC through the court's 09 April 2003 Order; Respondents filed an appeal before the Court of Appeals, 8th Division, which was dismissed by the said court through a Resolution dated 11 August 2004 on the ground that the case was purely a question of law; The case reached the Supreme Court, 3rd Division, wherein the court denied the petitioners' (respondents originally) Petition for Review on Certiorari on 15 June 2005. On 31 August 2005, the court resolved to deny with finality the Motion for Reconsideration filed by the petitioners SPM, et al.; Coming now to your queries vis-b-vis the factual backdrop thereof, we believe that the same can be addressed jointly and concisely. Since the Supreme Court, without delving on the merits of the Decision rendered by the RTC, denied with finality the Petition for Review on Certiorari filed by the petitioners SPM, et al., the RTC Decision is rendered final and executory. We therefore find no legal impediment for the SPM over which you are the presiding officer to recognize Mr. Natalio F. Beltran Ill as ex-officio Member of the SPM, without need of further concurrence from the SPM since as Liga President, he is entitled to seat as an ex-officio member of the sanggunian per Section 494 of the Local Government Code, which provides that the duly elected President of the

-4- Liga at the city level shall serve as ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Panlungsod. Parenthetically, let it be stressed that per the ruling of the Supreme Court in Bito-onon vs. Fernandez (G.R. No. 139813, 31 January 2002), it was held that the DILG only exercises supervision, not control, over the Liga ng mga Barangay. Hence, the proper body to recognize Mr. Beltran's incumbency as Liga Chapter President is the National Liga Board, as what the latter already did through the Certificate of Confirmation dated October 23, 2002. Likewise, since a subsequent Certification dated 04 June 2004 was issued by Mr. James Marty L. Lim recognizing Mr. Beltran as the Liga Manila Chapter President, the same suffices for Mr. Beltran's recognition as such. Anent the issue as to the validity of the legislative acts of Mr. Carlos Castaneda during his tenure as ex-officio Member of the SPM, the same shall be considered valid since his performance as SPM ex-officio Member is justified under the "de facto officer" principle. As to whether or not the continuous assumption of Mr. Castaneda as ex-officio Member of the SPM despite knowledge of the RTC and Supreme Court Decision and Resolution, respectively, constitutes contempt, we regret not to render an opinion thereon in deference fo the authority of our judiciary to determine the same. We hope we have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, A Legal:87/La cc: The Regional Director DILG National Capital Region LMP Building, Ermin Garcia St. Cubao, Quezon City Hon.
